result.summary: Found 2 issues: one critical content/localization bug and one minor layout issue.

issues.description: The section title 'home_feed.popular_title' is a raw localization key that was not resolved. Instead of displaying a human-readable label like 'Popular near you', the untranslated i18n key is shown directly to the user.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the localization/translation system correctly resolves the key 'home_feed.popular_title' to its intended display string before rendering the UI. Check that the locale file contains the key and the translation pipeline is functioning.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is partially clipped, cutting off the restaurant name. While some clipping is expected to hint at scrollability, the name truncation is too aggressive and may confuse users.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the card width and text truncation allow enough of the restaurant name to be readable, or add an ellipsis in a more visible and intentional way.
